subject.title: fix(telegram): record sent messages in the source-delivery path

question: Should this PR wait for live Telegram proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override the external-PR proof gate based on the stubbed Bot API evidence?
rationale: The code path and focused tests are convincing, but only a real Telegram source-delivery followed by a reaction proves the user-visible ownership-routing behavior end to end.

options.title: Capture live Telegram proof
options.body: Run the automatic source-delivery and reaction scenario through Mantis, then merge after the rebased checks pass.

options.title: Explicitly override proof
options.body: A maintainer may accept the focused real-ledger and stubbed-API evidence while knowingly owning the untested Telegram integration boundary.

options.title: Pause pending proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a maintainer or contributor can provide a redacted live Telegram transcript or recording.

recommendation.title: Capture live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Run the automatic source-delivery and reaction scenario through Mantis, then merge after the rebased checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Telegram delivery/refactor history makes this the best available owner for deciding whether the live integration proof gate may be satisfied or overridden.
